name: CXMT back-end test base phase 2, Hefei
aliases: 后道测试基地二期项目

parties.name: ChangXin Memory Products (Hefei)
parties.note: 长鑫存储产品（合肥）有限公司, wholly owned by CXMT, which already carries out part of the company's own DRAM testing according to the prospectus.

summary: A planned DRAM test factory for CXMT, the second phase of its back-end test base, to test memory chips and assemble modules in Feixi County, Hefei. CXMT's board approved the project on 28 September 2026 and its shareholders on 19 October 2026, with a total investment of CNY 10.8 billion and a 37-month construction period; CNY 5 billion is to come from surplus proceeds of its STAR Market listing, provided to its wholly owned subsidiary ChangXin Memory Products (Hefei) through capital injection and loans. The company said the plant would keep test capacity from holding back production, secure its supply chain and lower DRAM test costs.

location.address: 合肥市肥西县创新大道与皋城路交叉口西南侧
location.note: Feixi County, Hefei: the announcement places the project south-west of the junction of Chuangxin Avenue and Gaocheng Road and says the new projects are inside the company's existing plant areas; the implementing subsidiary is registered in the Feixi County Economic Development Zone.

metrics.note: Total planned investment, including about CNY 8.2 billion for equipment and installation and CNY 1.7 billion for buildings; CNY 5 billion of it is to be funded from surplus listing proceeds.

milestones.note: Approved by the board on this date and announced the next day, together with a separate CNY 24.1 billion research and development project; shareholders approved both on 19 October 2026.
